name: hira_faceless
desc: Turn this into a still-forming, faceless paint humanoid: the head becomes a smooth rounded lump of thick dripping brown paint with NO ears, NO eyes, NO muzzle, NO mouth, NO nose, NO hair, only a vague head-shaped blob on the neck. The body keeps the same chest, shoulders, arms, size and pose, but looks wetter and more melted: thick brown paint drooping and dripping everywhere, muscle shapes softer and blurry, glossy, and the lower legs melt down into a wide puddle of the same paint on the floor. Same colors, cream swirls, outline and pixel art style.
